model_info.target_semantics: Classes are HORIZON labels: a predicted failure class means the machine is on the approach to that failure within the next 15 readings, not that it has already failed.

alarms.message: Thermal gradient 8.53 K is below the 8.6 K minimum while speed 1251 rpm is below 1380 rpm.
alarms.cause: Temperature difference between the cutting process and the ambient air is below 8.6 K while spindle speed is under 1380 rpm - the milling machine cannot shed its heat.
alarms.recommended_action: Check the coolant supply and concentration, clean the coolant filter and spindle-chiller fins, verify the spindle cooling fan. Reduce the cutting load until the temperature delta recovers.

alarms.message: Overstrain Failure predicted within the next 15 readings (~2.5 operating hours) - 60% confidence. The machine is still running; act now.
alarms.cause: Product of cutter wear and spindle torque has exceeded the strain limit for this product variant - the end mill and spindle are being overstressed.
alarms.recommended_action: Reduce feed rate and depth of cut immediately, replace the worn end mill, and inspect the spindle bearings and tool holder for damage.

alarms.message: Early degradation trend on Tool Wear Failure - stress at 37% of its limit.
alarms.cause: The milling cutter (end mill) has exceeded its usable wear life (200-240 min); edge degradation causes poor surface finish and rising cutting forces.
alarms.recommended_action: Change the end mill (or re-grind it) at the next production break and reset the CNC tool-life counter after the tool change.
